name: Spike Growth
summary: 20-foot-radius patch of spiky Difficult Terrain: 2d4 Piercing for every 5 ft a creature moves in it.
text: Hard spikes and thorns sprout from the ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. The area is Difficult Terrain for the duration, and a creature takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels into or within the area. The spikes look natural: a creature that couldn't see the area when you cast the spell must take the Search action and succeed on a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check against your spell save DC to notice the danger before entering. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
